_comment: Model names change often; edit here. Each entry is called through an OpenAI-compatible chat/completions endpoint. A provider is skipped if its key env var is not set.

checkers.name: lexical
checkers.role: Check each Hebrew word against the English: is every word rendered, and is each rendering a defensible meaning of that Hebrew word?

checkers.name: meaning
checkers.role: Check meaning and completeness: is anything added, dropped, or shifted in sense compared with the Hebrew? Flag theologically loaded word choices.

checkers.name: style
checkers.role: Check against the PAR style guide: modern English, no thee/thou or -eth forms, KJV rhythm kept, protected words unchanged, no paraphrase.
